Ava (partnerships): Heads up — vendor sync today. Main asks: regional thermal constraints, PSU limits for H100/H200/B200 racks, and coordinated announce cadence across EU/APAC/NA. Can folks share latest delta vs spec?

Ravi (hw-ops): Quick update: OEM said H200 firmware patch reduces peak draw by ~8% but only after BIOS v2.4; GA dates differ by region. We have test results in lab-rt-23.

Lina (marketplace): Marketplace note — we need final image tags and SKU mapping at least 72h before soft-announce to stage images. If EU is delayed, we can keep SKUs hidden until go-live.

Miguel (platform): From runtime side we can gate rollouts by region. Recommend NA -> EU -> APAC with 24h canary windows each. That buys time for thermal observations.

Ravi (hw-ops): Also thermal callout: rack airflow settings for DC-C (APAC) require different fan curves due to higher ambient temps. That reduces sustained throughput ~10% on long/persistent prompts.

Ava (partnerships): Proposal: staggered announce cadence: NA April 8, EU April 10, APAC April 13. @Lina can you stage hidden SKUs and confirm health endpoints?

Lina (marketplace): Yep, can do hidden SKUs. I need final tag names, a health-check URL, and the SKU description string. I'll prepare a deployment checklist and toggle playbook.

Ravi (hw-ops): Quick lab snapshot: 
```
Model | Req BIOS/FW | Peak (W) | Sustained (W)
H100  | BIOS 1.9    | 650      | 520
H200  | BIOS 2.4    | 720      | 610 (with patch)
MI300 | FW 3.1      | 680      | 580
Gaudi | revB        | 400      | 340
```

Miguel (platform): Good data. We should prepare an automatic fallback route to a quantized variant when thermal throttling exceeds threshold. Ops: can you add a routing rule that drops to q4/8 model variant and notifies SRE?

Ravi (hw-ops): Yes, we can add the rule. Need to coordinate with Miguel for the metric name and threshold (suggest CPU temp > 78C or GPU package power > 95% sustained).

Ava (partnerships): Action items: (1) Ravi confirm final BIOS cutoff + rollback plan, (2) Lina create hidden SKU tags + health endpoints, (3) Miguel implement region gating + fallback routing, (4) Partnerships draft staggered PR language and embargo windows. Target: sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to close.

announce-bot: Reminder — calendar invite created for vendor-sync: 2026-04-02 10:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood.example/abc :spiral_calendar:

Lina (marketplace): Acknowledged. I'll post the checklist in the invite and tag owners. :thumbsup:

Miguel (platform): I'll add the feature-flag PR and a stubbed routing policy before sync.

Ravi (hw-ops): I'll upload the extended lab logs (lab-rt-23) and the BIOS validation matrix to the shared drive ahead of the meeting.

Ava (partnerships): Thanks all — see you tomorrow.
